```python
def normalize_pass1(s):
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"\([^)]*\)", "", s)  # remove parentheticals
```

```python
import re

alt_map = {
  'birds of prey': 'harley quinn: birds of prey'
}

def aggressive_normalize(s):
    s = s.lower()
    # map alternates first (this may change canonical forms)
    for k,v in alt_map.items():
        if k in s:
            s = v
    # strip after colon or dash
    s = re.split(r"[:\-]", s)[0]
    # remove parentheticals and punctuation
    s = re.sub(r"\([^)]*\)", "", s)
    s = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9\s]", "", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s).strip()
    return s

world_p2 = [aggressive_normalize(t) for t in worldwide2]
dom_p2 = [aggressive_normalize(t) for t in domestic2]
print("world_p2:", world_p2)
print("dom_p2:", dom_p2)
```
